topic.title: Generated JSON Schema Documentation in HTML Format

body.p: After generating the JSON Schema documentation, it is presented in a visual diagram style with various sections, hyperlinks, and options.

fig.title: JSON Schema Documentation Example Opened in a Browser

body.p: The generated documentation includes a Table of Contents on the left pane with links to particular sections in the right pane. You can collapse or expand details by using the Showing options or the Collapse or Expand buttons.
